# Merge into the "hooks" key of ~/.claude/settings.json (qm never writes it).
# The SessionStart/SessionEnd entries replace the existing qm ones - kept side by
# side, every session would be captured and injected twice.
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "REPO/quartermaster hook-session-start"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],

      {
        "hooks": [

            "type": "command",

        ]

          }

      }
    ],

      {
